## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change. Link the agreed issue, or explain why this is a small documentation/translation correction.

## Validation

Record actual environments, commands and results. Distinguish SQLite, real MySQL 5.7, synthetic audio and real-device checks. State anything not run and why.

## Compatibility and data

List API/schema/dependency changes, migration/recovery needs and known limitations. Write "none" when appropriate. Use fictional screenshots/logs only.

## Review checklist

- [ ] One purpose; no unrelated formatting/refactoring.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and reviewed every changed line, including generated code.
- [ ] Scope/dependencies/schema/API changes have explicit maintainer agreement, if applicable.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and refusal/error paths are tested; results are stated honestly.
- [ ] PHP 8.4 / MySQL 5.7 requirements remain intact; applicable real-MySQL checks are documented.
- [ ] DE/EN strings, accessibility, responsive layout and both day/night palettes are checked where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, real data, unauthorized reference code, tracking or public runtime files.
- [ ] Security, privacy, quotas, session and authorization rules remain intact.
- [ ] Documentation and contributor/license notices are updated where needed.

## AI assistance

Disclose substantial assistance, or state "none". Do not include private prompts or account information.
